name: WayriCAD QuickTherm
description: Saved-board thermal screening with editable inputs, transient heating and interactive board results.
description_full: Read-only steady-state and scheduled spatial-transient thermal screening using declared dissipation, thermal paths and heat capacities. Editable scanned component inputs, copper-layer and vertical-path models, virtual heatsinks, mounting boundaries, interactive top/bottom/3D views, heating playback, cross-selection and local HTML/JSON evidence. Air and vacuum use declared thermal boundaries, without airflow fields. An optional Gmsh/CalculiX mode solves bounded 3D steady conduction with a fixed lower-face temperature; junction estimates require separate RthetaJB. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib is required. This is not CFD or coupled electrothermal simulation.
